notes.title: Freakpocalypse Episode 2 News!
notes.content:
Ahoy there! 
 
Since the first game in our Freakpocalypse trilogy released just over a year ago, we thought now would be a good time to update you on the next game. We know many of you have been waiting to hear what the status on Freakpocalypse Episode 2 is, so we thought you all might enjoy some details and a sneak peek at what we’ve been working on for the second game. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987565/eb6c408da9aca844759ff478e233139458c6c179.png[/img]
 
What’s To Come in Freakpocalypse Episode 2? 
[list]
[*] Longer Gameplay Overall – Expect a much larger main quest with more fun to explore along the way
[*] We’re in the apocalypse now, mothafuckas! – Coop is no longer stuck in his humdrum teenage life, as he’s now thrust into a post-apocalyptic world, fighting for his survival amidst total chaos 
[*] Much more puzzle diversity – New puzzles and mechanics that span from mini-games to boss fights and more 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987565/d1838b2e44b9a35520dcdae37c3438c9c7ee317f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Speaking of New Mechanics – Powers, mini-games, companions, environment effects, and even Grandma will help you survive the ever-changing, dangerous Netherton landscape 
[*] Boss Fights – We’ve been working on some fun ways to include boss fights into the storyline. It’s still a point-and-click adventure game, but now with some exciting new twists 
[*] Multiple Solutions – Have fun trying out different ways to solve puzzles and potentially discover secrets, easter eggs, and other interesting results along the way!  
[*] More legacy characters – How will Ted Bear survive the apocalypse? Is The Purple Shirted Eye Stabber still alive? How will Fart In A Jar Martin manage to stay alive in this hellscape? Tons of characters you know from Cyanide & Happiness have arrived to help make long lasting memories and unbridled chaos 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987565/d11ea60f22eb0dad262f7c5735beb48d2d12c91c.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Company For Coop – Coop isn't alone as he interacts with the world, flirts with objects, and more (while still being an unpopular weirdo) - this time he has new companions who are along for the ride  
[*] More Ways to Die – We had only a few ways for Coop to die in the first game, but things have taken a far deadlier turn now that he’s in the post-apocalypse. Expect more blood, gore, corpses, and general horror for poor ol’ Coop to deal with. School is out, death is in! 
[*] Merchants – An in-game shop and economy (NOT micro-transactions or NFTs), for more in-universe fun and bonuses
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987565/a40f91239cdb4f65ef2bfa32df95056a3df4e551.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Callbacks to the first game – You'll learn all about not just what has happened to Coop, but other characters and how they're dealing with post-apocalyptic life 
[*] Beyond Quests - More to do outside of active quests, replayable mini-games to top your best score, deeper character interactions, and reactive environments 
[*] More Music – Having so many new locations to explore in the post-apocalypse, we’ll naturally have a wider variety of music to reflect the mood 
[*] Pick Up From Where You Left Off - We plan on Items and Costumes from the first game to be carried over to Freakpocalypse 2
[*] Secrets - We can’t tell you what they are... but there’s a lot more of ‘em! 
[/list]

While we can’t announce a set release date for Freakpocalypse Episode 2 just yet, you can see we’ve 
been quite busy with it. We’re working nonstop on it, but we’re not going to rush the release 
when we have so much fun stuff planned for this next game. We’ll be sure to keep you posted 
whenever we have more updates regarding the release date, second game title, and more later 
on down the road. 
 
Thanks again for your patience and support!

notes.title: Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.10 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]General Updates & Additions:[/b]
- Using UI-Cancel in the main menu will now return the user to the title screen.
- Added a quit confirmation pop-up to the game over death screen.
- Added visual cues to repairing printer cable.
- Hobo Moe now follows the player in front of Golden Haze to block entry.


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Bug fix where hanging Sawyer’s flyers was being marked off early in the notebook tasks list.
- Added missing sound effects to generic chairs interaction.
- Fixed an issue with multiple voice over clips playing when grabbing certain costumes.
- Fixed a Bernie repeating narrative issue when returning to him on Day 2.
- Fixed a Firedash repeating narrative issue after completing Condom Conundrum sidequest. 
- Updated chore, item, and costume pop-ups to better fit text.
- Fixed a narrative issue when talking to Stevie Shades after completing his side chore.
- Fixed navigation issue when interacting with the ice cream truck.

notes.title: Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.09 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.09 Patch Notes

General Updates & Additions:[/b]

- Added more signposting to an optional item pickup.
- Updated requirements for “Desperate Times” achievement.
- Added the new “Coming Clean” achievement.
- Added line graphics to highlight the Load Autosave section on the Loading screen, as some players didn’t realize the game had an Autosave function in addition to the manual save slots.

[b]Localization Updates:[/b]
- Updated character names.
- Updated various dialogue lines.
- Updated missing translations.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Fixed a bug with the “Project Runway” achievement that caused it to unlock prematurely.
- Fixed an issue where the Bullies appeared on Knothole Street and interacting with the nearby roadblock signs caused the game to softlock.
- Fixed a bug where you could pick up two of the same inventory items at once.
- Fixed an issue where interactions for both Coop’s locker and Chet’s body overlapped.
- Fixed one of Coop’s reactions to Hobo Moe.
- Fixed minor typos.

notes.title: Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.08 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.08 Patch Notes

General Updates & Additions:[/b]

- Made adjustments to the text display on the endgame Report Card.
- Fixed a backer NPC’s name.
- Miscellaneous adjustments to the game credits.

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]

- An issue existed with some graphic cards that would not allow MP4s to play through our in game video player. We have replaced MP4 with WebM cutscenes for a smoother and more universal video fix.

notes.title: Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.07 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.07 Patch Notes

General Updates & Additions:[/b]

- Adjusted desk pen cup holder collider on Coop’s desk so it can’t interfere with red pen item.

[b]Localization Updates:[/b]

- Bug where dialogue sometimes appears blank when not in English language has been fixed.
- Dialogue choice text scaling issues (mostly with French translations) have been fixed.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Bug where players are unable to perform interactions in the initial classroom has been fixed.
- Duplicate copies from the “Scathing Mulch Letter” bug should be removed from inventories.
- Bug where plastic bag stays in inventory after use has been fixed.
- Main Menu options language selection scaling issues have been fixed.
- Shark Dad achievement not completing if the outfit was unlocked first has been fixed.
- Grading on the endgame Report Card has been adjusted so higher grades can be reached.
- Chores and Tasks text appearance in notebook have been adjusted to prevent cut-offs.

notes.title: Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.06 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse v1.06 Patch Notes

General Updates & Additions:[/b]

- New Report Card added to end of game allows player to see what they did & didn't accomplish.
- New "Point of No Return" options have been added to the end of Day 1 and before the final game area, so players can choose whether to continue forward or stick around longer in order to complete side quests, find more costumes, discover hidden characters, etc.
- Quarter size has been increased due to poor visibility on smaller screen resolutions. 
- Quarter relocated elsewhere due to the size increase making it too easy to spot in its original location.
- Missing elements restored to Circle J cashier countertop.

[b]Localization Updates:[/b]

- Updated missing lines discovered in Simplified Chinese dialogue 

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Finger Trap bug that allowed Coop to bypass Droogs entirely has been fixed.
- Beret costume element vanishing from Coop's wardrobe upon loading saved game has been fixed.
- Delay in receiving "Hobo Hindrance" side quest until after house chores were completed has been fixed.
- Cutscenes not loading and/or displaying infinite "Loading" animation has been fixed.
- Main menu "Missing UI" error appearing on some player screens has been fixed.
- Players being able to receive infinite copies of the "Scathing Mulch Letter" inventory item has been fixed.
- "Desperate Times" Trophies are now functioning properly. 
- "Speed Demon" Trophies are now functioning properly.
- "Gotta Got 'Em All" Trophies are now functioning properly.
- "Don't Slurp That" Trophies are now functioning properly.
- "PermaPeeper" Trophies are now functioning properly

notes.title: Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse (Episode 1) Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]High school can feel like the end of the world, but in this case, it actually is![/h1]
We're happy to announce that [i][b]Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse (Episode 1)[/b][/i] is [b]NOW AVAILABLE[/b] on [b]Steam[/b], [b]Epic Games Store[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch![/b] Grab our point-and-click adventure for [b]10% off for the first week![/b]

[previewyoutube=VkygtpGWN_8;full][/previewyoutube]

Coop just wants to make the world a better place, and why shouldn't he? It's not like he constantly injures others, causes significant property damage, or generally makes life worse! He'll be fine...

Maybe.

Join Coop as his efforts to put up some flyers causes more harm than good! Will Coop finally make his first friend? Can he make it to prom alive? Why is his neighbor a shark? Find out these answers and more in the chaotic world of [i]Cyanide & Happiness - Freakpocalypse![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987565/45de1c56e9e40e41adeefde2e486ef9bc505c4af.gif[/img]

Keep a lookout for some fun, special activities we've got going on today on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/explosmentertainment][b]Explosm Youtube channel[/b][/url]! We've got a Freakpocalypse animated short coming out, as well as a stream hosted by your very favorite friend, The Mutant!

We want to again say thank you all so, so much! We've poured our love, creativity, and appreciation for our fans into Freakpocalypse, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it! Coop's story has just begun – as this is the first game in the Freakpocalypse "tragilogy" – and trust us when we say: He's got a looong way to fall before he's done!

notes.title: Cyanide & Happiness - Freakpocalypse (Episode 1) -- Out on March 11th!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wx4wnyXq-gY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]The Freakpocalypse is coming, but first you've got to survive high school.[/h1]

Hey friends and folks! You've been waiting for it, and we're here to lay  it on you: We're REALLY happy to tell you that [b][i]Cyanide & Happiness - Freakpocalypse (Episode 1)[/i][/b] will be available [b]March 11th, 2021[/b] on [b]PC[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b]! 

Now you, too, can experience what it means to be a lonely, constantly distraught high schooler as we begin our trilogy of tragedy! Follow along with Coop's journey as he does normal student things, like:
[list]
[*] Get a hall pass
[*] Avoid getting killed by bullies
[*] Try and find a prom date
[*] Look at, touch, and talk to virtually everything
[*] Start a dialogue with over 100 bizarre characters including a suburban survivalist, disgruntled retirement home residents, horrible school faculty members, your horny grandma, and even a dad who's also a shark named Shark Dad.
[/list]
We know fans and backers have been waiting for [i]Freakpocalypse[/i], and with good reason; it's been a painstaking process to make sure that we got the hallmarks of a true point-and-click adventure game just right. We wanted to be thorough, and that meant voicing a full cast of characters, writing an insane amount of dialogue, and making sure that you can look at, touch, and talk to everything.

On launch day, join the developers and their good pal, [b]The Mutant[/b], as they stream the sheer chaos that is the world of [i]Cyanide & Happiness - Freakpocalypse![/i] Find them on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/explosm][b]Twitch[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/869880/Cyanide__Happiness__Freakpocalypse/][b]Steam[/b][/url], or Explosm's social media channels to watch along!

We're grateful you've stuck with us this far, and we're more than happy to say you're in the home stretch! Sharpen your pencils, pack your lunch, stuff your bra, and get ready for a [strike]miserable[/strike] wonderful journey through Netherton as Coop totally DOESN'T have a trainwreck of a time. Who said that? Not us!
